articles.headline: Ajay Mitchell scores a career-high 35 points as Thunder rout Grizzlies 128-97
articles.description: — Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 35 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Memphis Grizzlies 128-97 on Friday night in an NBA Cup group stage game.
